content_sections.heading: About RRI
content_sections.text: The Raman Research Institute, Bengaluru, is funded by the Government of India and, in its own words, is a premier institute engaged in basic science research. This post is for the Institute's ERP system, which serves its core administrative functions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from individuals for the single post. The candidate must have excellent and consistent core competence and aptitude in full-stack software development. B.E or B.Tech with first class from a UGC recognized University/Institution. Minimum three years experience as a Full Stack Developer with strong understanding of web development principles and best practices; proficiency in HTML, CSS, Java Script, Python, Django, MySQL/PostgreSQL, Linux OS and software package installation; familiarity with AI tools and version control systems. Excellent problem solving skills and attention to detail; strong collaborative and communication skills. More than one year experience in ERP development in Government or Autonomous Science and Technology organizations/institutions. Good knowledge and understanding of various workflows of administrative processes. The upper limit is 35 years as on the last date for closing of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated remuneration of ₹42,000 per month plus HRA as applicable as per the norms will be paid to the selected candidate. The appointment is on a temporary basis, initially for one year, with a possible extension by another year after review. The selected candidate has no claim for regular or permanent appointment during or after the training period. Either side may end the engagement by giving one month's notice, or as per the applicable terms of engagement. No accommodation is provided on the Institute campus during the tenure.

content_sections.heading: RRI Senior Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Development, feature enhancement, maintenance and upgrade of the ERP system for the Institute's core administrative functions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRI Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: Apply online at the application link, safal2.rri.res.in, by filling up the application form. Upload the relevant documents and certificates in support of the application. Submit the application on or before 20 December 2026 (23:59 hrs). Applications submitted physically or through any other mode will not be considered, and applications received after the last date will not be considered. For additional information or clarification, the notice asks candidates to write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for the Screening Test/Interview, using qualifications and criteria higher than the minimum prescribed. Mere fulfilment of the essential qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called. Call letters and information are sent only to shortlisted candidates through their registered email address. The interview date is not given in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Project Associate posts has RRI announced?
faq.answer: The Raman Research Institute has announced one post of Senior Project Associate under Advertisement No. 26/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the RRI Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 20 December 2026 (23:59 hrs). Applications received after that will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the RRI Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: B.E or B.Tech with first class from a UGC recognized University/Institution, plus a minimum of three years' experience as a Full Stack Developer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper limit is 35 years as on the last date for closing of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the RRI Senior Project Associate?
faq.answer: A consolidated remuneration of ₹42,000 per month plus HRA as applicable as per the norms.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or allowances paid on top of the ₹42,000?
faq.answer: The notice says HRA as applicable as per the norms is paid plus the consolidated ₹42,000 per month. It names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through safal2.rri.res.in, by filling the application form and uploading the relevant documents and certificates. Physical applications are not considered.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the interview. The Institute may shortlist candidates for the interview, and only shortlisted candidates are called.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is temporary, initially for one year with a possible extension by another year after review, and the selected candidate has no claim for regular or permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the Screening Test/Interview.
